decision: No explicit same-computation-graph historical reopening or banned-mechanism conflict found in the bounded sources. The proposal is technically implementable for root selection. This does not establish efficacy, task-deficit evidence, literature novelty, or training admission; no model implementation was authorized or performed by this review.

read_scope.candidate_ledger: Current research_work candidates id/experiment_id/stage/hypothesis/name/mechanism only; regex-targeted recurrence/state/sibling/sort/directional terms. No evidence/history expansion.
read_scope.historical_indexes: Targeted recurrence/RNN/GRU/LSTM/sequence/tanh/attnpool/agg terms in the named indexes only; no global history clearance.

history_boundaries.difference: Per-scale dense Q/K/V/out softmax self-attention with residual+LN versus parent-segmented shared nonlinear recurrent state, without QKV/softmax/new residual. Shared broad intra-scale interaction intent alone is insufficient to call the graphs equal.

Self+six nearest directional depthwise terms, one pointwise GELU; explicitly permits cross-coarse-parent edges. Proposed variable-length bidirectional state paths remain inside actual coarse-parent groups. It is not a kernel-size/neighbor-count alteration of MDC.
Those replace point-to-cluster pooling with content attention or learned point weights. Proposed raw cluster mean banks and pooling remain unchanged; replacement occurs on middle token refinement.

No refined-child-to-parent pooling chain, affine prolongation, coarse-feature channel Gram, reversible transport, point contact graph, same-leaf point attention, extra point update, or point-coarse attention is proposed. Existing held/rejected IDs are not reopened. This comparison uses current named mechanism descriptions and previously bounded source context, not a new exhaustive source audit.

ban_review.pure_scaling_or_activation_tweak: No: Wh creates off-diagonal token dependence. tanh is part of the new recurrence, while native YAML activation_fn remains unchanged. This is not an activation-only config experiment.
ban_review.gate_or_language_routing: No new learned gating or language/query-dependent donor choice is in the formula. Original HCG gate is retained.
ban_review.large_QKV: No Q/K/V attention projections or attention matrix. Wx/Wh/Wo are state transforms, not renamed attention projections.
ban_review.residual: Entire middle residual FFN is replaced, without a new residual skip/branch. Existing native point update and fine/coarse residual FFNs remain baseline behavior.
ban_review.attnpool_agg_multi: No changed raw aggregation, multiple point injections, or repeated decoder-layer injection. The broad word aggregation does not establish equivalence to the verified banned point-weighted-pooling graph.
ban_review.resource_or_Phase1_relaxation: None. Fewer analytic dense MACs/parameters are not a measured resource pass; original fixed seed/schedule/data and standard limits remain.

required_implementation_boundaries: Keep PointCloudPartitioner/FPS, original ids0/ids1/ids2, child_cluster_maps, raw feature aggregation and CSORT byte/semantically unchanged. Add detached current-batch geometry cache only; do not replace the partitioner or canonicalize point rows.
Use original ids2[b] for middle-to-coarse parent assignment. Do not use the CSORT child_cluster_maps inverse direction as this assignment.

Distinguish valid per-batch middle prefix (ids2[b].numel()), true point-supported middle slots from composed ids1[ids0], and batch padding. Use geometry/membership-derived boolean masks; never feature magnitude or coordinate zero as validity.

Define/freeze the centroid formula and detached cache lifetime before code: preferably the already-reviewed cascade of original-ID geometric means, not a silent switch to point-mass reweighting or new FPS centers. Empty-centroid placeholders must never enter supported-token sort/state transport.

Lexicographic xyz ordering with exact original-token-ID tie break must yield a permutation of supported native middle IDs. Scatter recurrent outputs back to the original middle positions; never reorder output bank/ids/maps or ground-truth rows.

Reset both directional states to zero for each batch and each actual coarse parent; precompute Wx once, share Wx/Wh across directions, Wh without bias as specified; do not detach recurrent feature states.

Delete the replaced middle FFN parameters rather than leaving dead trainable parameters. Preserve original middle LayerNorm, fine/coarse FFNs, raw CSORT, HCG, single final point injection and all YAML numeric values.

Set unsupported/padded middle outputs to zero as explicitly declared. M95 HCG gathers middle rows only via composed ids1[ids0] (hier_postprocess.py:601-620), and its global_mean is point_feats.mean (line624), so unsupported zero rows are not directly read back; excluding them from recurrence prevents phantom state bridges. Raw CSORT must still consume raw banks.
mechanism_falsification_and_limits: Probe off-diagonal h1-to-mu1 derivatives only on the direct captured middle-refinement path: same-parent generic nonzero, cross-parent exactly zero. Shared model parameters across tokens do not by themselves constitute a same-forward cross-parent dependency.

A real nonsingleton parent must exercise Wh in native two-batch loss/backward; all observed gradients finite and an actual optimizer update of the intended module are required to demonstrate the path was used. Unexercised singleton-only data are missing coverage, not efficacy evidence.

Use the declared state-reset-at-each-token intervention with identical Wx/Wo/inputs/order/masks/readout to cut history edges. It diagnoses transport sensitivity; it does not establish improved localization or isolate every difference from original M95.

Stable sorting means deterministic association only for the frozen FPS/centroid inputs. Tied centroids use token IDs; bidirectionality with arbitrary Wo concatenation weights does not imply reversal, rotation, or token-relabeling invariance. Near-tie sorting can be sensitive to centroid reduction rounding.
Serial GEMMs/sorting and tanh saturation or recurrent gradient products remain performance/numerical risks. Two finite native steps would not prove long-training stability or benefit.
No verified task-error deficit for this exact recurrence is supplied. The current proposal remains a falsifiable structural hypothesis, with efficacy and external novelty UNKNOWN.
